name: Imgflip
recommendation: Use a selected catalogue subset; do not equate a blank template with a finished reply.
verified: A live get_memes response returned IDs, names, asset URLs, dimensions and template box counts.
The response includes broadly used English-oriented formats such as This Is Fine, Two Buttons and Absolute Cinema.
access_status: Public catalogue endpoint read successfully. Paid search and caption endpoints not exercised.
context_quality: Names and template metadata; no validated situation-to-reaction labels.
asset_status: 40 source-listed URLs retained. Four of those images were visually spot-checked; not a complete image download.
caveats: Popularity/captioning activity is not a quality or conversational-fit score.
Underlying media rights were not established.
Provider search has caching/integration requirements; do not assume the same rules apply to every endpoint.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Memegen
recommendation: Use selected named records and source-listed examples; deduplicate and inspect before display.
verified: The live catalogue exposes template IDs, names, blank and example URLs, keywords and source links.
The observed response contained duplicate astronaut and db IDs and an incomplete both record.
access_status: Public catalogue read successfully. No bulk media download completed.
context_quality: Metadata and reference leads, not reliable standalone usage explanations.
asset_status: 20 source-listed URLs retained: 19 example URLs and one blank facepalm image. Facepalm was visually spot-checked.
caveats: Example captions can be situation-specific, not universal reactions.
The software repository licence does not establish clearance of underlying movie, TV or other images.
Not every source link was independently read.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Know Your Meme
recommendation: Use selected entries to investigate meaning, variations and origin; keep factual claims distinct from proposed uses.
verified: The site describes editorial/community research with review by editors and moderators.
Selected entries explain meaning and usage beyond the image appearance.
access_status: About page and selected meme pages read. No public bulk export or supported bulk API verified.
context_quality: The strongest cultural reference source in this comparison, as an assessment of the inspected pages, not a measured benchmark.
asset_status: No media copied from this source.
caveats: An explanatory article is not a set of human preference labels.
Do not assume bulk copying or redistribution permission.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Reaction GIFs
role: Usage-context reference and future reaction assets
recommendation: Prioritize for reaction-use ideas; do not pretend page descriptions are a downloadable licensed GIF dataset.
verified: Several inspected entries include How It’s Used sections.
The Stone Cold entry describes a shift from amusement into seriousness when a statement turns out not to be a joke.
access_status: Home, tag index and selected entries read. Raw media links for the evaluated pages could not be resolved with the available web tool; no bulk export/API verified.
context_quality: Strong direct relevance to choosing replies; editorial claims were not systematically fact-checked.
asset_status: Five additional page-level leads are supplied separately without direct media URLs. None is counted among the core 60.
caveats: GIF timing may carry meaning that a still frame loses.
Do not train on guessed actor/origin credits.
No media redistribution permission established.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: KLIPY
recommendation: Evaluate with an authorized API key when you need maintained GIF/meme/clip delivery, rather than a static dataset dump.
verified: Official developer pages offer meme, GIF, sticker and clip APIs.
The documentation distinguishes standard media delivery from approved caching integrations.
access_status: Developer documentation inspected. No authenticated request, production approval or catalogue-wide sample inspected.
context_quality: Search/API availability is documented; actual relevance quality was not tested.
caveats: Published integration/caching requirements must be followed.
Provider marketing scale claims are not benchmark evidence.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: GIFDB
role: Manual discovery only in this release
recommendation: Exclude from automated collection without permission.
verified: The site has ready-made reaction categories.
Its Access section says ordinary automated scripts/bots are not the intended access method, except public XML RSS feeds.
Its Linking section restricts direct large-file linking and integration without permission.
access_status: Category and terms pages inspected; no automated media collection undertaken.
context_quality: Category labels are broad; no systematic situation-use annotations verified.
caveats: Terms are a concrete collection blocker for the proposed bulk dataset, not merely an absent API.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Memedroid
recommendation: Use for discovering candidates, not as automatically trusted training labels.
verified: The inspected site exposes finished user-submitted memes, tags, votes and time-window browsing.
access_status: Home and terms inspected. No bulk export or supported API verified.
context_quality: Votes signal engagement with a post, not appropriateness as a reply to a different conversation.
caveats: Topic-specific captions and variable moderation make blind ingestion unsuitable.
Bulk access and redistribution rights not established.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Memebase / Cheezburger
recommendation: Use to discover formats and finished examples; do not treat collections as clean reaction records.
verified: The site publishes themed collections of memes and internet humour.
access_status: Home and terms inspected. No structured bulk export or supported dataset API verified.
context_quality: Collection-level editorial framing; uneven per-image context.
caveats: A compilation can mix formats, screenshots and content that only makes sense in its original post.
Bulk permissions not established.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Frinkiac
recommendation: A strong source to investigate in the dialogue phase; not a general meme corpus.
verified: The creator’s May 2026 account describes improved subtitle alignment, neighbouring transcripts and GIF/comic tools.
It describes deduplicating neighbouring frames so search results do not overrepresent one scene.
access_status: Creator documentation read. The application was not fully inspectable in the text browser; no supported bulk export verified.
context_quality: Dialogue and local scene context are useful; conversational deployment labels are still missing.
asset_status: No frames, subtitles or media included.
caveats: One-show cultural scope.
A site supporting sharing is not blanket permission to distribute its entire media archive.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Morbotron
recommendation: A focused dialogue extension after meme selection works.
verified: The creator describes search, meme and GIF functionality for Futurama.
The May 2026 modernization account says the shared updates are live on both Frinkiac and Morbotron.
access_status: Creator launch and modernization accounts read. No supported bulk export verified.
context_quality: Scene/transcript context; not human-ranked reply preferences.
caveats: Do not use the 2016 launch counts as current catalogue size.
One-show scope and unresolved bulk media rights.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Clip.Cafe
recommendation: Reserve for dialogue research or an explicitly authorized integration; exclude from this archive.
verified: The site offers transcript/scene-description searches with movie, character and duration filters.
The terms state access for personal use subject to restrictions and reserve intellectual-property rights.
access_status: Interface and terms inspected. No open bulk dataset or approved app integration verified.
context_quality: Potentially useful scene context; retrieval suitability for meme replies not benchmarked.
asset_status: No clips, scripts or transcripts included.
caveats: Personal-use website access is not a demonstrated right to package clips in a public dataset.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.

name: Meme Depot
recommendation: Interesting material to browse, but not a verified exportable dataset backbone.
verified: The landing page describes saving images/GIFs/videos with AI tagging and searchable collections.
access_status: Public landing page and visible collection descriptions inspected; no public API or export verified.
context_quality: AI tags may assist discovery; label quality and cultural coverage were not tested.
caveats: Collection counts need not represent unique reusable reactions.
No blanket reuse permission established.
review_method: Selected official pages, API responses or creator documentation; not a complete site crawl or legal audit.
